name: Williamson County, TX
findings: Williamson County has 1,169 nonprofit organizations. 513 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 399 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Williamson County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Williamson County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few research and think tank organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 research and think tank organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 19 would.

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through research and think tank groups? Where else does that happen?
